description: Vigor is priced per RANK at the tier that rank was bought at (feat/vigor-rank-stamp, 2026-08-05), the same way species traits are priced per trait at the lock state in force when bought. Two ranks are bought at 1 Hit Die (tier 1, 5 AP each = 10), then the character levels to 5 Hit Dice (tier 4). Vigor must STAY at 10; before the per-rank stamp it re-priced the whole stack at the new tier (2 x 14 = 28), so a player was charged 18 AP for Vigor they already owned, purely for levelling. The third rank, bought AFTER the level-up, correctly costs the tier-4 rate (14) in the same build - which is the asymmetry the fixture exists to pin.
